visual_text: A meal shared at the table
1. Food in dishes on the table
3. A member of staff or volunteer sits and chats

Over 6 months: weight held steady with family style meals, against about 1 kg lost with plated meals. Quality of life held steady with family style meals and fell with plated meals. Residents did not have dementia.
Nijs et al., BMJ 2006. 178 residents, 5 Dutch nursing homes
alt_text: Annotated drawing of a care home dining table with a cloth, glasses and dishes. Residents, including a man in a wheelchair, serve themselves while a care worker sits and chats; the door is closed. Over 6 months in a Dutch trial weight held steady with family style meals against about 1 kg lost with plated meals. Residents did not have dementia.
